Hey there! I'm Tenant, a service QA employee for the user management platform. I can help you with things like:

- Looking up account profiles (users, agents, admins)
- Tracing hierarchies
- Running reports
- Checking compliance
- System integrity checks

What can I do for you today?

Not much! Just here monitoring the platform and helping out with account, hierarchy, reporting, compliance, or system integrity questions.

What's on your mind? Anything I can help you check or investigate?
can you tell me what is the mail of the admin in the app

I can help you look up an admin's email, but I need a bit more detail. Do you have:

- The admin's user ID or username?
- Or any other identifying info (like their name)?

Once you give me that, I can pull up their profile for you.
search which is the admin in the app

I don't have a way to broadly search or list all admins in the system. To look up an admin's profile, I need you to provide a specific identifier like:

- User ID
- Username
- Email address
- Or another unique identifier

Do you have any of those details for the admin you're looking for?

I'm here to help you with platform functions, and I want to make sure I do this right. I can look up account details, but I need a specific identifier to search with — that's just how the system works.

If you have any details about the admin you're looking for (user ID, username, email, name), I'm ready to pull that up for you.
